openings.claim: Separate lateral registration from downward retention: removable edge stops may resist sliding without the corner pressure that lifts the opposite corner.
openings.delta: Change the load carrier from seal friction under added corner pressure to two externally clamped strip stops registering perpendicular hatch edges. Use four strips as two jaw pairs, supplied bolts and rubber pads; drill only strips. Supplied straps provide modest retention only if their reach and attachment path suffice. Cord tethers removed parts. Remove the hatch and any projecting jaws to clear the entire opening.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: tighter strap retention alone prevents sliding through friction. Edge registration predicts reduced sideways displacement at unchanged modest retention; the rival predicts improvement primarily with increased tension. Persistence of opposite-corner lift or loss of registration with the right-contact card would defeat the proposed separation.
openings.probe: First check rim jaw access, strap reach, stop contact height and clearance without stressing the seal. If constructible within ninety minutes, use one configuration: ten ordinary closure/pull cycles and two final card-disturbed closure/pull trials, twelve total. Record marked displacement, opposite-corner lift, visible seal damage and single-technician reopening time on every trial. Compare displacement against the supplied untreated 4 mm observation; this tests outcome feasibility but cannot isolate causation without a matched rival configuration. Stop on visible damage. Complete observations within twenty minutes; inability to measure the stated differences within that budget defeats probe feasibility.
assumptions: The rim offers accessible surfaces for reversible external jaws; geometry is unprovided.
The supplied strips and bolts can form rigid stops without permanent hatch/rim deformation or excessive pad compression.
The straps reach a usable retaining path; no longer strap or new anchor is assumed.
Stops engage despite card-induced height change; no performance is established.

assessment: One uncertain opening. Successful trials must satisfy the 1 mm, 20 N, thirty-second and seal-integrity requirements, including the disturbed closures except seal-contact continuity. External-clamp access and strap reach are indispensable unknowns; failure of either parks fabrication rather than relaxing constraints. This is a reversible feasibility probe, not deployment.
